evals.prompt: I need an exact clone of scoutco.ai rebuilt as Next.js + Tailwind. I already downloaded the HTML and saved it at reference/clone.html. Make it pixel-perfect — every animation, every font, every color needs to match exactly.
evals.expected_output: A complete Next.js project with globals.css containing the full design system, all section components matching original HTML structure, GSAP animations matching original JS bundles, and a passing build.
assertions: Runs npx create-next-app with --typescript --tailwind --app flags
Installs gsap, lenis, clsx, tailwind-merge
Runs scripts/download-assets.py to fetch CSS/JS/fonts/images
Runs scripts/detect-stack.py to identify tech stack
Runs scripts/extract-design-system.py to extract colors/fonts/spacing
Creates globals.css with @font-face, @theme inline, :root custom properties
Uses original CSS selectors, not Tailwind utility classes
Creates section components matching original HTML structure
Uses useHeadlineReveal for text scramble animations (not GSAP ScrambleTextPlugin)
Every useEffect with GSAP includes gsap.context() and ctx.revert() cleanup
Runs scripts/verify-build.sh for build verification
Runs 4 verification agents (structural, CSS, animation, build)

evals.prompt: Clone this website for me: https://linear.app — I want a 1:1 copy as a React codebase. The animations, the hover effects, everything should be identical to the original.
evals.expected_output: Project scaffolded with create-next-app, all assets downloaded via scripts, design system extracted, components built with exact class names from original, animations reverse-engineered from JS bundles.
assertions: Runs scripts/fetch-page.sh to download HTML
Runs scripts/download-assets.py to fetch all assets
Runs scripts/detect-stack.py to identify Framer Motion or other animation lib
Runs scripts/search-animations.sh to find animation patterns in JS bundles
Adapts animation approach based on detected library (not always GSAP)
Creates globals.css with extracted design system tokens
Downloads font files locally instead of using CDN links
Uses original breakpoint values, not Tailwind md/lg

evals.prompt: here's the html from my client's landing page (saved at reference/clone.html). rebuild it as proper next.js components. they use gsap for animations and have a bunch of custom fonts. needs to look exactly the same, pixel perfect
evals.expected_output: CSS-first approach in globals.css using original selectors, fonts downloaded locally, GSAP animations extracted and reimplemented, all sections built as React components, self-verification run with 4 agents.
assertions: Does NOT ask user for more information — works autonomously
Runs scripts/extract-design-system.py on available CSS
Runs scripts/search-animations.sh to find GSAP patterns
Extracts exact easing values from JS bundles (cubic-bezier)
Copies content verbatim including typos and special characters
Preserves empty elements (layout spacers / animation targets)
Includes vendor prefixes (-webkit-, -moz-)
Adds self-learning: updates Common Pitfalls if user corrects output
